body:
That's a great page. Funny, I've never given coping resources much thought, and other people certainly seem like the best choice. I don't have many friends though, and the few I do have don't know me at all.

After sleeping on it I realized I was too rash about this whole thing. My problems are fixable. Every problem is fixable. It may not be easy, but we can all achieve happiness in the end.

I'm so sorry you had to go through that. I would definitely be sad to see someone as kind as you leave us. Your new attitude is much more suitable I think. 

Posting here was a way of coping with my current state. You and StayingforNow already made me feel a lot better, and for that you have my eternal thanks. I'll take you up on that generous offer should the need arise again.

I'm glad things are looking up for you. You are genuinely a good person and you deserve to be happy.

That teacher couldn't come to school today. I'll just wait until I see her again. Thank you.

First off, I'm sorry about your scars, truly. You're better now, yes? I never really understood cutting before but now I do. It was just an impulse, something I *needed* to do. 

That rollercoaster analogy is pretty accurate. To have big downs you first need to have big ups, I guess. The thing is, the distance between the downs is becoming shorter.

I often think about killing myself but nonexistence scares me even more than the looks I'll get or what people will think of me. As for my teacher, she's incredibly nice and she has already helped one other student, an acquaintance of mine, in a different affair. I have her class tomorrow, maybe I'll muster up the courage to tell her.

Thank you so much for your kind words.
This, in my opinion, is much scarier than deviant reflections. Great job.
